faqs.q1: How does the agency subdomain setup work?
faqs.a1: During agency workspace creation, you select your studio slug (e.g. "atelier-events"). Your client invitations, RSVP links, and couple dashboards immediately operate at atelier-events.eventframe.io with cookie isolation and custom branding.
faqs.q2: Will our couples see EventFrame branding or ads?
faqs.a2: No. On agency plans, client-facing pages (digital invitations, RSVP questionnaires, live reception display, and the couple portal) are presented cleanly with your studio identity and zero external advertisements.
faqs.q3: Can couples accidentally alter our agency settings?
faqs.a3: No. EventFrame enforces strict role separation. Couple portals are scoped exclusively to their individual wedding event via their unique access PIN. They cannot view your agency billing, other couples, or studio settings.

faqs.a4: Yes. Each wedding event within your agency workspace can have its own Display Art Aesthetic (Natural Garden, Minimal Luxury, Romantic Love, Vintage Noir, and more) along with custom invitation canvas layouts.

faqs.q1: What hardware is required to run the wedding reception display?
faqs.a1: Any standard laptop (Mac, Windows, or Chromebook) connected to a projector, large smart TV, or LED wall via HDMI or AirPlay. The display runs inside full-screen Chrome, Safari, or Edge.
faqs.q2: How quickly do guest photos appear on screen?
faqs.a2: Submissions sync in real-time. Once approved in the moderation dashboard, photos and notes animate onto the screen within seconds.
faqs.q3: What happens if venue Wi-Fi is slow?
faqs.a3: EventFrame uses lightweight vector styling and progressive image loading. Once the display URL is loaded in full-screen, incoming messages stream smoothly with low bandwidth consumption.
faqs.q4: Can couples download the full gallery of guest photos after the wedding?
faqs.a4: Yes. All submitted guest messages, candid reception photos, and timestamps are permanently stored in the couple portal for high-resolution download.
